mentions.name: Canine
mentions.description: This open source platform is an alternative to Heroku, Fly.io, and Render, built on top of Kubernetes to deploy and manage applications. It lets teams avoid the 5-10x markup of PaaS over IaaS and the pain of stitching together AWS services, follows opinionated Kubernetes best practices, and supports one-click installs of any Helm package (e.g., self-hosted Sentry at sentry.your-domain.com), which it manages.
mentions.problem: PaaS platforms (Heroku, Fly.io, Render) apply a 5-10x markup over IaaS (AWS, Hetzner), while trying to stitch together random AWS services is a huge pain for a medium sized engineering team.
mentions.audience: medium sized engineering teams that find stitching together AWS services painful
mentions.source_excerpt: Currently working on an open source Heroku / Fly.io / Render alternative: https://canine.sh
